::: {#def-fwer}
#### Family-wise error rate

For a family of tests with $V$ false positives (@def-rejection-counts),
the **family-wise error rate** (FWER) is the probability of at least one false positive:

$$\text{FWER} \eqdef \Prf{V \ge 1}.$$

A procedure **controls the FWER at level $\siglevel$** if $\text{FWER} \le \siglevel$
for every possible set of true null hypotheses.
:::
